comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 c5 5. Nb5 Na6 6. c3
comments.comment:
Against ...c4, b3 hits the chain at once: (6... c4 7. b3)
After ...cxd4, take back with the e-pawn: (6... cxd4 7. exd4)
Against ...Qb6, a4 keeps the knight on b5: (6... Qb6 7. a4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 c5 5. Nb5 Na6 6. c3 Bd7 7. a4
comments.comment:
If Black takes on b5, take back with check, then Nf3 and Ne5: (7... Bxb5 8. Bxb5+ Nd7 9. Nf3 Nc7 10. Bxc7 Qxc7 11. Ne5)
Against ...c4, develop with Nf3; after ...cxd4, take back with the e-pawn: (7... c4 8. Nf3) (7... cxd4 8. exd4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 c5 5. Nb5 Qa5+ 6. b4 Qxb4+ 7. c3
comments.comment: If the queen goes to b2 instead, the fork comes all the same, and Ne2 then guards c3: (7... Qb2 8. Nc7+ Kd7 9. Ne2) (7... Qb2 8. Nc7+ Kd8 9. Ne2)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 Bb4 5. Bd3
comments.comment:
Against most moves, Nf3 and castle: (5... Nc6 6. Nf3) (5... Nbd7 6. Nf3) (5... c6 6. Nf3) (5... h6 6. Nf3)
Against ...Ne4, Ne2, so that ...Nxc3 doesn't wreck our pawns: (5... Ne4 6. Ne2)
After ...Bxc3+, take back with the pawn: (5... Bxc3+ 6. bxc3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 Bb4 5. Bd3 O-O 6. Nf3
comments.comment:
Against the quiet moves, castle: (6... Nbd7 7. O-O) (6... Nc6 7. O-O) (6... Ne4 7. O-O)
Against ...h6, g4 goes for the king: (6... h6 7. g4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 Bb4 5. Bd3 c5 6. dxc5
comments.comment:
After ...Bxc5, Nb5 hits c7 with the f4-bishop: (6... Bxc5 7. Nb5)
Against ...Qa5, Ne2 guards c3 a second time: (6... Qa5 7. Ne2)
Against ...Nc6, develop with Nf3: (6... Nc6 7. Nf3)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 Bb4 5. Bd3 c5 6. dxc5 Nbd7 7. Nf3 Nxc5 8. O-O
comments.comment: Against ...O-O, Bg5 pins the knight; after ...Nxd3, take back with the c-pawn: (8... O-O 9. Bg5) (8... Nxd3 9. cxd3)
g5 next, as against everything: (5... Be7 6. g5) (5... b5 6. g5)
After ...Ne4, take, and Bg2 hits the e4-pawn: (6... Ne4 7. Nxe4 dxe4 8. Bg2)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 a6 5. g4 c5 6. g5 Nfd7 7. Qg4
comments.comment: After ...cxd4, take back with the e-pawn: (7... cxd4 8. exd4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 a6 5. g4 c5 6. g5 Nfd7 7. Qg4 Nc6 8. O-O-O
comments.comment: After ...cxd4, take back with the e-pawn: (8... cxd4 9. exd4)
Against ...Bd6, Qf3 as usual: (6... Bd6 7. Qf3)
After ...cxd4, take back with the e-pawn: (7... cxd4 8. exd4)

comments.at: 1. Nc3 d5 2. d4 Nf6 3. Bf4 e6 4. e3 a6 5. g4 Bb4 6. Ne2
comments.comment: With the knight on e2, ...Bxc3+ no longer wrecks our pawns. Next a3 asks the bishop; if Black grabs g4, Rg1 hits the knight: (6... c5 7. a3) (6... Ne4 7. a3) (6... Nxg4 7. Rg1)

comments.comment: If the knight retreats, h4 and h5 follow: (6... Nfd7 7. h4) (6... Ne8 7. h4)
